categories.main_business_segments: Kengic Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent logistics and intelligent manufacturing systems. Its main business includes design, R&D, production, sales, and services of intelligent logistics systems such as intelligent conveying and sorting systems, and intelligent manufacturing systems including intelligent warehousing and smart factory systems. The company also provides core equipment and information system solutions for these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in adaptive control for high-speed automatic sorting, information tracking in conveying systems, large-package sorting via turntable sorters, and high-efficiency cargo handling. It integrates mechanical, electrical, software, AI vision, intelligent algorithms, and big data technologies. Production methods emphasize modular, standardized, and parameterized design, supported by advanced software platforms like MES, WMS, WCS, SDS, and SFP for digital factory management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kengic serves major customers in express logistics, e-commerce, and manufacturing industries. Key clients include leading logistics companies such as SF Express, Deppon Logistics, YTO Express, and international e-commerce platforms like Coupang, JD.com, Shopee, Flipkart, and Trendyol. In intelligent manufacturing, customers span lithium battery, photovoltaic, automotive parts, chemical fiber, home furnishing, food cold chain, and other manufacturing sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qingdao and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Hong Kong, and South Korea. It has expanded overseas markets to countries including South Korea, India, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam, Turkey, Czech Republic, Israel, Germany, France, and the Netherlands, establishing localized sales, project delivery, and after-sales service capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kengic operates mainly as a midstream solution provider in the supply chain, focusing on system integration of intelligent logistics and manufacturing equipment. It designs, manufactures, and delivers core equipment and software solutions, integrating upstream components from suppliers and serving downstream logistics and manufacturing operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent logistics and manufacturing technologies, increasing R&D investment to develop new industry scenario solutions and core foundational technologies. Key R&D directions include high-speed sorting, intelligent scheduling, digital factory platforms, and new energy sector automation. It also focuses on expanding overseas markets and enhancing digital transformation and supply chain optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems, including hardware equipment and software platforms. Additional income comes from paid after-sales services, spare parts sales, and technical consulting. The company secures orders via direct sales, competitive bidding, and customized solution contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kengic is positioned as a leading domestic provider in intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems, competing with international giants like Dematic, Daifuku, Vanderlande, Rockwell Automation, ABB, and FANUC in high-end markets. Domestically, it competes with companies such as Beiziso, Today International, Lanjian Intelligent, and Kunshan Shipbuilding. It differentiates itself by covering intelligent logistics, warehousing, and factory systems comprehensively and by expanding its international footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Kengic reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.15 billion, a 31.2% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 77.9 million. Despite revenue decline due to market competition and project cycle effects, new order intake reached a record high of over RMB 2.3 billion, up 45% year-over-year, indicating strong future growth potential. The company’s total assets grew by 4.52% to RMB 2.64 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.22 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kengic emphasizes its proprietary core technologies and integrated solutions that combine hardware, software, and intelligent algorithms to deliver high-efficiency, customizable intelligent logistics and manufacturing systems. Its products improve operational efficiency, reduce labor intensity, and enable digital transformation for clients. The company’s comprehensive service capabilities, including end-to-end project delivery and after-sales support, alongside its strategic international expansion, provide competitive differentiation.
